reproducibility_gaps: The repository uses ranged core dependencies and optional dependency groups rather than one exact unified environment lock.
Accelerator-specific JAX/JAXLIB installation depends on the selected CPU/GPU/TPU backend and is not pinned to one hardware target.
Bundled notebooks, examples and model assets are heterogeneous and are not individually normalized in this bounded supporting-software extraction.
notes: R2 reflects an immutable source snapshot, clear licensing, documented installation and package metadata while preserving non-locked multi-backend environment requirements.
